paper_metadata.title: Cr addition-mediated simultaneous achievement of excellent strength and plasticity in non-equiatomic Nb-Ti-Zr-Ta-based refractory high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: an as-cast non-equiatomic NbTiZrTa0.25-based refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA) with excellent specific strength and plasticity synergy was developed via Cr alloying modification
all dendrites and interdendrites in the Cr0 and Cr0.2 alloys possessed a BCC structure

were produced by arc-melting of the elements in a low-pressure, high-purity argon atmosphere inside a water-cooled copper cavity. The purities of the raw materials were higher than 99.96 % (by weight).
To obtain an ingot with a homogenous composition, melting via electromagnetic stirring was performed five times for each ingot.
The ingots were suctioned into the copper mold through a rod-like cavity measuring 4 mm in diameter and 60 mm in length to study their microstructures and mechanical properties.
